user.title: Connect to Cybersecurity Tuner
user.description: Enter the address of the Cybersecurity Tuner app and its Home Assistant API token (the app option `ha_api_token`, or the token the app generated in /data/ha_api_token).

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of the app, for example local-cybersecurity-tuner.
data_description.port: Port of the app's Home Assistant API (default 8099).
data_description.token: Bearer token used to authenticate against the app.

hassio_confirm.title: Cybersecurity Tuner app discovered
hassio_confirm.description: Do you want to set up Home Assistant to connect to the Cybersecurity Tuner app at {host}?

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Cybersecurity Tuner
reauth_confirm.description: The Cybersecurity Tuner app at {host} rejected the API token. Enter the current token.

data_description.token: Bearer token used to authenticate against the app.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the app.
error.invalid_response: The app returned an unexpected response. Is this a Cybersecurity Tuner app?

abort.already_configured: This Cybersecurity Tuner app is already configured.
abort.wrong_instance: The token belongs to a different Cybersecurity Tuner installation.
abort.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the app.
abort.invalid_response: The app returned an unexpected response.
abort.invalid_discovery_info: Invalid discovery information from the Supervisor.

data_description.status_interval: How often the app status is polled (seconds).
data_description.events_interval: How often new security events are polled (seconds).
